summary_proposal.value: Three bounded sources add comparisons of cfDNA methylation methods; none is a prospective screening study and none shows clinical benefit. Sun et al. 2024, an independent benchmark, ran five deconvolution methods on two real plasma cohorts and reported the ROC-AUC of a random forest trained on the estimated cell-type fractions, with no stated validation split. For 24 liver cancer patients and 32 healthy individuals (WGBS), AUCs were 0.96 (CelFEER), 0.93 (CelFiE), 0.91 (MethAtlas), 0.77 (cfNOMe) and 0.72 (UXM). On the cfMethyl-Seq cohort (each cancer type against 193 healthy individuals), AUCs ranged from 0.72 (UXM, lung squamous) to 0.93 (CelFiE, gastric), and no method was highest for every cancer type. Giuili et al. 2025, a preprint that benchmarks ten tools inside the authors' DecoNFlow pipeline on in silico mixtures of tumour tissue or cell-line reads in healthy plasma reads, reported the lowest overall median tumour-fraction limit of detection for CelFiE: 0.0070 (WGBS-TT), 0.0100 (RRBS-TT) and 0.0010 (RRBS-CL). CIBERSORT and EpiDISH RPC had overall medians of 0.1000 to 0.2500 across the three datasets. One block of its Supplementary Table 3 (RRBS-CL, five tools) conflicts with its Figure 4A and with the table's own overall medians, so those cells should not be cited until resolved. Nguyen et al. 2023, written by the SPOT-MAS developers, compared three tissue-of-origin classifiers on combined methylation and fragmentomic features from cancer patients only: in the independent validation cohort of 239 patients, overall accuracy was 0.53 (random forest), 0.69 (deep neural network) and 0.69 (graph convolutional network). Its stage-stratum sizes conflict with another table in the same file. Tissue-of-origin evidence therefore rests on one author-reported multimodal workflow, not on a methylation-only comparison.

vocabulary_changes.reason: Giuili et al. Supplementary Table 3 reports a limit of detection of the tumour fraction; no existing metric concept fits. Added without an external match (none was checked against a published definition).

not_extracted.reason: The -log10(p-value) block is a one-sided Wilcoxon test of the affected-tissue fraction, not a performance measure; no metric concept fits and the value depends on group size. The AUC block H2:M9 of the same sheet was extracted in full.
In silico deconvolution accuracy is shown in figures only.
AUC, 1-RMSE and Spearman results are shown in figures only.
S7 prints differences between stacked and single-feature models; S8 is a single-configuration sensitivity table. Recorded as leads.

gaps: Jamshidi et al. 2022 (CCGA substudy, several assays and classifiers on the same plasma samples) not retrievable: publisher pages returned HTTP 403.
cfSort, cfTools, DISMIR, Hill et al. 2023, PMC10417284 and PMC9744803 were noted but not opened.
